page.title: Filter catalog
page.empty: This catalog has no entries yet

actions.confirmDelete: Delete this entry from the catalog?

form.keyLocked: Cannot be changed — saved vehicles point at this code.
form.keyHelp: Lowercase, no accents. This is what gets saved on vehicles and appears in filter links.
form.keyPattern: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore only
form.label: Display name
form.descriptionHelp: Shown in small print under the name in pickers and filters. Optional.
form.iconUrlHelp: A file in the web app's public folder, or a full URL.
form.activeHelp: Disabling hides it from the vehicle form and filters; existing vehicles still show the right name.
form.vehicleTypesHelp: Leave empty for all vehicle types. Pick some to show this entry only where it makes sense.

models.title: Vehicle models
models.empty: This brand has no models yet
models.loadError: Could not load the model list
models.confirmDelete: Delete this model from the catalog?
models.label: Model name
models.labelHelp: Use the manufacturer's own spelling — this is the name guests see.
models.brandHelp: Fixed after creation: changing a model's brand would turn someone else's vehicle into another brand.
models.marketStatusHelp: Earlier models stay selectable, just in the second group of the picker.
models.motorbikeCategoryHelp: Motorbikes only. This is the dimension guests filter by.
models.fuelTypesHelp: Empty means unverified. Fill it in only when the whole model line has a single option.
models.engineDisplacementHelp: The manufacturer's actual figure — never derived from the model name.
models.seatCountHelp: Cars only. Leave empty when the model line ships with several seating layouts.
models.sourceUrlHelp: The manufacturer's product page you checked. Saved together with the date.
